/bookingSupportSteps/0/detail.source_en: Pick a date and pay nothing today — reserve now & pay later.

/bookingSupportSteps/0/description.source_en: Reserve online; instant confirmation includes the cruise detail intake form (ship name, port, all-aboard time).

/bookingSupportSteps/1/detail.source_en: Share your ship name, arrival date, and dock — we confirm timing within 24 hours.

/bookingSupportSteps/1/description.source_en: Send us your cruise details within 48 hours of booking so we can adjust your 8-hour period.

/bookingSupportSteps/2/detail.source_en: Send any preferred or skipped stops at least 2 days before the tour.

/bookingSupportSteps/2/description.source_en: Optionally adjust your stop list (add or swap attractions) up to 24 hours before — we'll confirm the revised route.

/bookingSupportSteps/3/detail.source_en: Vehicle plate number, driver name, and contact phone are sent the day before.

/bookingSupportSteps/3/description.source_en: Driver details (name, vehicle plate, meeting point at the terminal) sent the evening before.

/bookingSupportSteps/4/detail.source_en: Driver waits at the arrival hall with an AtoC Korea sign within 30 min of disembarkation.

/bookingSupportSteps/4/description.source_en: Driver meets you at the cruise terminal arrival hall with a name placard for your group.

/bookingSupportSteps/5/detail.source_en: Drop-off at the same cruise terminal at least 60 minutes before your all-aboard call.

/bookingSupportSteps/5/description.source_en: Drop-off at the same terminal at least 60 minutes before all-aboard; brief feedback form sent afterward.

/practicalWeatherStatic/advice.source_en: Layered clothing in spring/autumn; sun protection and light rain shell in summer; warm coat and gloves in winter for the coastal cliffs at ⟦G0⟧.
/practicalWeatherStatic/advice.tm: Habillez-vous en plusieurs couches au printemps et à l'automne ; protection solaire et coupe-vent léger en été ; manteau chaud et gants en hiver pour les falaises côtières de ⟦G0⟧.

/practicalWeatherStatic/summary.source_en: Busan has a humid subtropical climate with four distinct seasons. Cruise season concentrates in spring (Mar–May) and autumn (Sep–Nov), both pleasant 12–25°C with low rainfall. Summer (Jun–Aug) brings warm humid weather and occasional monsoon showers. Winter (Dec–Feb) is cool and windy.
/practicalWeatherStatic/summary.tm: Busan jouit d'un climat subtropical humide à quatre saisons bien marquées. La saison des croisières se concentre au printemps (mars–mai) et à l'automne (sept.–nov.), deux périodes agréables de 12 à 25 °C et peu pluvieuses. L'été (juin–août) est chaud et humide, avec des averses de mousson occasionnelles. L'hiver (déc.–févr.) est frais et venteux.
